data.body: Phase 2 local evidence on refreshed origin/main 1bba2641a7d: held-out oracle was collected and RED before implementation because the coupled comparison did not raise under a production-only jira-to-plain format drift; the fixer could not read the oracle. After the independent fixture implementation it was GREEN in 0.13s. Reintroducing the copied live-constant oracle made it RED again, and restoring the fix returned GREEN in 0.20s. Runtime measurement of the repaired 23-chunk oracle observed exactly 884 real production Pandoc Popen calls, zero Pandoc subprocess.run calls from a copied oracle, and 33.1792s total. Paired baseline was 65.5558s, so measured local saving is 32.3766s / 49.4 percent and 884 subprocesses. Both Pandoc version and binary-fingerprint mismatch controls were rejected. Fresh full regeneration produced byte-identical 464,007-byte fixture SHA-256 f09e8bff0ae1d88ae5cd80b3216e1306c62c0ebc4497ad66b3a3edd93b7b54fa. Focused hardening, corpus, and generator suite: 56 passed in 26.56s after main refresh; exact-file hooks, lint, and typecheck passed. Commit 6c4492fac6ff2cced37debd4544be40ed6b17e20 is Gerrit change 1764; Verified run 31773167187 is in progress.
